title: Zoos are old now: Supreme Court allows UP's proposal for night safari in Kukrail reserve forest
description: The Uttar Pradesh government can proceed with its proposed night safari project in the Kukrail Reserve Forest, Lucknow, the Supreme Court ruled on Wednesday [Ashok Kumar Sharma (IFS, Retd.) & Ors. v. Union of India].However, the same should be subject to conditions imposed by the Central Empowered Committee (CEC) and the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), the Court underlined.A Bench comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi
